Independent symbolic subtraction reproduced the displayed rational centered Q with numerator P=5r^3+(5d+7gamma)r^2+2gamma^2*r-4d*gamma*(d+gamma). Noise κ contributes only isotropic trace, not Q. P'(r)>0, P(0)<0, P(2d)=12d^2(5d+2gamma)>0, hence unique root in (0,2d) and exact variance sign ordering. For fixed 0<r<2d, P is concave quadratic in gamma with one positive gamma zero; this orders the r roots strictly with gamma. Implicit asymptotics yield (2/sqrt5)sqrt(d gamma) near gamma=0 and 2d-12d^2/gamma at large gamma. Boundary gamma=0 not asserted; density isotropy not asserted. Checked the polynomial and expansion independently with sympy; algebra and renewal derivation, not finite samples, support all parameters.
